page_title: MAI 3-0 DOR | Mainz v Dortmund 11/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Tobias Stieler has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
87' The referee signals a substitution. Marco Richter (Mainz) is brought on as a substitute for Jae-Sung Lee.
87' Bo Henriksen prepares a substitution. Brajan Gruda is replaced by Nelson Weiper (Mainz).
87' The free kick is whipped into the box and finds Sepp van den Berg (Mainz), who plants a header just over the bar from close range.
84' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
80' Tobias Stieler shows the yellow card to Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) for a heavy challenge.
77' Substitution. Silvan Widmer will be replaced by Danny da Costa (Mainz).
76' It will be a substitution. Kjell Watjen (Dortmund) is ready to enter the pitch as Jamie Bynoe-Gittens walks off.
76' The attendance is 33000.
76' Bo Henriksen decides to make a substitution. Anthony Caci will be replaced by Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz).
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
72' Tobias Stieler has a clear sight and sees a foul from Silvan Widmer (Mainz).
70' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
69' Edin Terzic has decided to make a change. Ole Pohlmann (Dortmund) replaces Felix Nmecha.
68' Mainz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
64' Tobias Stieler blows for a foul after Niklas Sule (Dortmund) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
62' Dortmund failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
61' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Dortmund.
59' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
56' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) sees a yellow card from Tobias Stieler after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
54' Marco Reus (Dortmund) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

54' Marco Reus (Dortmund) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Corner kick. Dortmund will have an opportunity.
53' Celebrations are cut short for Dortmund as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
53' Wait! Referee Tobias Stieler immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
53' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
49' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!

48' He should have scored! Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Alexander Meyer makes an easy save.
46' Edin Terzic makes a switch. Jadon Sancho is coming on in place of Donyell Malen (Dortmund) at the start of the second period.
46' Edin Terzic makes a half-time substitution. Julian Brandt comes on in place of Salih Ozcan (Dortmund).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Mateu Morey Bauza (Dortmund) comes off for Ian Maatsen.
46' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' The foul by Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Tobias Stieler.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
43' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
41' Today's referee Tobias Stieler rightly decides to book Marco Reus (Dortmund) for his harsh tackle.
40' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
35' Marco Reus (Dortmund) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
34' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

34' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) accepted an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashed a decent strike towards the top right corner of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, was alert and thwarted the effort.
32' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) makes a rough challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Alexander Meyer (Dortmund) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Robin Zentner's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the top of the net.

28' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Tobias Stieler with no other option than to blow for a foul.
23' 3 - 0 Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets low into the middle of the goal.
23' Mainz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
19' 2 - 0 GOAL! Keeper Alexander Meyer totally miss kicks his clearance straight to Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz), who rifles the ball back into the net from close range. It’s now 2:0.
16' It looks like Marco Reus (Dortmund) saw red with that tackle. Tobias Stieler won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
16' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) was too forceful with his tackle and Tobias Stieler interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
12' 1 - 0 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) unleashes a quick low drive into the middle of the net and past the goalkeeper. Here is an example of luck being on your side.

8' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the free kick from just outside the box and attempts to convert it into a goal. He hits it magnificently and the keeper must be relieved to see the ball hit the bar and ricochet away.
7' The referee blows his whistle as Mateu Morey Bauza (Dortmund) was too aggressive in his challenge. Mainz are awarded the free kick.

7' Marco Reus (Dortmund) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Robin Zentner pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
4' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The first half has started.
Dortmund will kick the game off.
Tobias Stieler will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
